voice.title: Voice
voice.subtitle: Set how your brand sounds in drafts — tone and words to avoid.
voice.readOnly: Ask a company admin if you need changes.

roast.label: Tone strength
roast.hint: Higher is sharper and more playful. Default works for most posts.

locale.label: Locale
locale.hint: Main writing locale for drafts, e.g. zh-HK.

forbidden.label: Words to avoid
forbidden.hint: Up to 15 phrases, separated by commas. Drafts will try to skip them.

tone.label: Tone notes
tone.hint: Optional. A few short lines about the feel you want.

exemplars.label: Example captions
exemplars.hint: Up to 3 — you don't need to fill them all. One strong caption is enough for rhythm. You can also save one after Confirm.

products.importHint: Rows with the same product code update existing ones.
products.alreadyPending: This product code is already waiting for review

products.coverBody: Drafts use the company version. Your personal copy stays for you until you ask to update the company list.

fields.notesHint: Optional. Selling points, ingredients, or anything drafts should know.

overwrite.body: Product code {{sku}} already belongs to {{name}}. Update that row, stay and change the code, or use a generated code for a new row.
